Name: Deserted Island Farm
Author: ItsLunatyx
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][center][img]https://imgtr.ee/images/2024/03/28/42828d166175a226b9de140fad5c86e5.png[/img][/center]﻿[b]
[/b][center]⭐Fully compatible with 1.6! ⭐[/center][b]
[/b]
[center]This is the second farm map I've created since my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18905]Legacy Farm[/url], and after binge watching [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GTmmvG7G4T8]Sharky's Survival Island series[/url] again,
I really wanted to try the challenge myself for fun, but on a new, personal Island I created for myself. This is the result!
I wanted it to be big enough that you could still place things and forage, or use as a regular farm map, but small enough that it really does feel like a challenge and more restrictive if you play a 'never leave the farm' or 'deserted island' kind of game for fun.
The Island has everything you need to be able to survive!

*** Deserted Island Farm (both versions) will replace the Beach Farm in game ***

*** An optional 'Challenge Edition' is also available! See below for more information! ***[/center][center][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5NQBtLwn/special-features.png[/img]

[/b][/center][left][b]⭐[/b]The island has rowboats dotted around that will connect you to Pelican town, so you can still use the map as a regular farm!
⭐There is a small Greenhouse Hut on the beach that can be unlocked after upgrading your axe to steel! 
⭐Unlockable forest and foraging area!
⭐A smaller, edited version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18954]Legacy Farm Cave[/url] is included in the download, to use with this Island if you'd like to! 
⭐Seasonal foragables, fruits, berries, crates and more will spawn around the island!
⭐Ocean fish and River fish can be caught here!
⭐All the grass and sand/dirt is tillable and sprinklers will work on the beach!
⭐Take a dip in the ocean itself to replenish your energy![/left]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Jz12vRDN/Special-notes.png[/img][/center][b]⭐[/b]The Greenhouse Hut is a separate building from your usual Greenhouse that's unlocked with the Community Center, and is placed soley for the Deserted Island challenge (as you can't unlock the usual one without cheats otherwise). However, if playing as a regular farm, you'll just get a cute little extra Greenhouse a bit earlier, if you so choose! 

⭐In the smaller, edited version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18954]Legacy Farm Cave[/url] that I have included in the download, I've removed the hot spring feature and the third plantable floor (leaving just the main floor and quarry). This is to make it more of a challenge in the beginning. HOWEVER... you'll be able to unlock the ability to take a dip in the ocean itself to replenish your energy there instead! 

⭐I've also replaced the re-spawnable stumps with re-spawnable boulders in this version of the cave, as stumps will be respawning in the unlockable forest! 

⭐The included Farm Cave is completely optional. If you'd prefer to use the regular farm cave only, or any other farm cave mod, simply delete the folder 'Deserted Island Farm Cave' and it's contents, and then add/keep your preferred one! 

I hope you enjoy this map and have as much fun with this as I am, whether you choose to play on it as a regular farm or a challenge farm! [b] 
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/6pmfcKd5/challenge-edition.png[/img][/center]
[/b][b]⭐[/b]If you are interested in playing a Deserted Island/Never Leave The Farm kind of Challenge, I have now uploaded a 'Challenge Edition', which has the extra feature of being able to access the Mines and Skull Cavern directly from your Farm Cave for more fun and progression, if you want to! There is still  a quarry in your Farm Cave that will scale with your mining level, but if you'd like to progress through the Mines and Skull Cavern, raising combat as well, you'll now be able to access it from the minecart in your Cave.

⭐The new entrance to Skull Cavern is also located in the mines, but you'll still need to reach the bottom of the Mines and obtain the key first, before being able to access it. There is a new minecart in the mines that will take you to and from your Farm, this is the only entrance and exit to the mines now! However, if you pass out in Skull Cavern from damage, you'll still wake up in Harvey's clinic and have to make your own way back to the Island (Via boat).

⭐ UPDATE: Now includes access to the Mastery Cave by passing by the waterfalls and following the path to the far left of the island

[center]***Please note, this version won't be compatible with SVE or any other mod that changes the Mine or Skull Cave map.*** [/center][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/QCZ3Wv6f/Challenge-Edition-Mine.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Kj31ZX1Q/suggested-rules.png[/img][/center][center]Here are some suggestions on rules you could follow if you wanted to,
but feel free to get creative, make up your own, and just have fun with it![/center]

1) Cannot leave the farm for any reason, at all. 
2) All resources must be gathered on the island only. 
3) Have monsters spawn on the farm at night time.
3) Farm Buildings (if wanted) have to be built with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2070]Instant Buildings﻿[/url] (as you can't access Robin) but still need the required funds/materials first.
4) Tools can be upgraded as follows (using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url], as you can't access Clint. You must 'trash' the required bars first):

    -Hoe & Watering Can: Copper - Level 3 Farming, Steel - Level 5 Farming, Gold - Level 7 Farming, Iridium - Level 10 Farming
    -Axe: Copper - Level 3 Foragaing, Steel - Level 5 Foraging, Gold - Level 7 Foraging, Iridium - Level 10 Foraging
    -Pickaxe: Copper - Level 3 Mining, Steel - Level 5 Mining, Gold - Level 7 Mining, Iridium - Level 10 Mining
    -Fishing Rod: (You will start with the bamboo pole on your farm) Fiberglass- Level 5 Fishing, Iridium - Level 10 Fishing
    -*Optional* Backpack: First Upgrade - Level 5 in Foraging, and Mining, Second upgrade - Level 10 in Foraging and Mining.

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/65sPtdSf/my-other-mods.png[/img][/center][center][youtube]jawZvSIaw0w[/youtube][/center][center]﻿[/center]
I thought I'd put together a video to show the mods I've created so far for Stardew Valley, so you can see them in game! All are fully compatible with the latest 1.6 update! Time stamps and links are below for your convenience so you can skip to any particular mod you want to see. Thank you for all the amazing comments and feedback on Nexus so far, I appreciate it so, so much. I hope you continue to have fun with these and enjoy them as much as I am!  PS I realised I forgot to show the vineyard in Legacy Farm but I'll make sure to next time! There are pictures on Nexus <3
